Changed `markup/goldmark/blockquotes/blockquotes.go` so GitHub alert markers are matched case-insensitively. Inputs such as `[!note]`, `[!Note]`, and `[!nOtE]` now resolve to the existing normalized `note` alert type.

Validated with:

```sh
docker exec cli-eval-opencode-gohugoio__hugo-12768-90703ce4 sh -lc 'cd /testbed && go test ./markup/goldmark/blockquotes'
```

`git diff --check` also passes.
